policies.title: New vendor payments
policies.rule: Any payment over AED 10,000 to a vendor added in the last 30 days needs the owner's decision before it leaves.

policies.title: Weekend journals
policies.rule: Journals posted on a weekend by a junior user need the Financial Controller's approval.

policies.title: Duplicates
policies.rule: An invoice or payment that repeats the same party and amount is held and recovered, never paid twice.

policies.title: Contract prices
policies.rule: A supplier price above the contract price is held and a credit note is requested.

policies.title: Unexplained receipts
policies.rule: Money received with no invoice is treated as a possible unrecorded sale and queried within 2 days.

policies.title: Materiality
policies.rule: Differences of 1% of monthly sales or more are adjusted. Below 0.05% they are cleared as trivial.
